title: The Effects of Combined Spinal Epidurals on Fever During Labor of First-Time Mothers
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine if the epidural of local anesthetics has an effect on fever that may occur in first time mothers during labor.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* having first child (nulliparous)
* term pregnancy (\> 37 weeks)
* vertex presentation
* singleton gestation
* ability to provide informed consent
* request for analgesia for labor pain

Exclusion Criteria:

* birth of second or more child (multiparous)
* preterm pregnancy (\< 37 weeks)
* presentation other than vertex (ie. breech, transverse)
* diabetic
* admit temperature \> 99.5
* active drug/alcohol dependence
* active genital herpes infection
* allergy to anesthetics used
